input.quote: 20.1 Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.
input.rationale: Section 20 meets the preferred position in full. Vendor defends and indemnifies Customer and its Affiliates for third-party IP infringement/misappropriation claims arising from the Services or Deliverables (20.1), and for Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, bodily injury/property damage, unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor, and Vendor's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud (20.2). Customer's reciprocal indemnity in 20.3 is appropriately narrow (unmodified Customer-supplied material and Customer's violation of law in authorized use), with carve-outs for Vendor Technology, modifications, combinations and instructions. Standard procedure (prompt notice, cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense, control of defence, settlement-consent protections) appears in 20.4, and the infringement remedies (procure, modify/replace, refund) in 20.5, with a matching termination right in 9.3. Notably, indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims under 21.3, so Vendor's indemnity is not subject to the general cap or to a super-cap — better than the fallback and favourable to us. No redline warranted.
